(1) 3D information helps in predicting future semantic segmentation; (2) a model based on a learnable sub module for each of the three tasks of predicting semantic segmentation, depth, and ego motion is able to achieve state of the art results; (3) our method is able to predict the future segmentation of objects even in the absence of them in the current frame; and (4) our method is robust to the presence of occlusion and clutter in the scene

(1) predicting future semantic segmentation of video sequences is a promising task for the future, (2) leveraging 3D information in the model is crucial for achieving high accuracy in this task.
